_comment: Extra profiles collected from public reference pages on 2026-10-26. These are summaries from comparison sites, not policy wordings. Verify every value against your actual policy before relying on it. Edit sum_insured and copay_percent to match your policy.

new_india_mediclaim.note: Room limit is 1% of sum insured per day (ICU 2%, not modelled). No co-pay unless you choose a voluntary one. Proportionate deduction can be removed only with a paid add-on.

new_india_sixty_plus.note: Mandatory 10% co-pay. Room limit 1% of sum insured per day (ICU 2%). Sum insured options are 2, 3 and 5 lakh; edit sum_insured to match yours.

star_assure_bought_after_61.note: Room rent up to 1% of sum insured; 10% co-pay if bought after 61. The source does not say whether proportionate deduction applies, so it is assumed ON. Confirm in your policy wording. Sum insured of 5 lakh is an example.

star_comprehensive_bought_after_61.note: Eligible room is a single private room, taken as the 'Single private' rent in your room_categories. 10% co-pay if bought after 61. Proportionate deduction assumed ON; confirm in your wording.

hdfc_myhealth_koti_suraksha_after_61.source: Ditto: Senior Citizen Mediclaim vs myHealth Koti Suraksha
hdfc_myhealth_koti_suraksha_after_61.note: Single private room; 20% co-pay if bought after 61. Proportionate deduction assumed ON; confirm in your wording.

hdfc_optima_secure.note: No room rent restriction and no mandatory co-pay, so any room is eligible.

niva_bupa_reassure_2.note: No room rent restriction and no mandatory co-pay. Other ReAssure versions differ (3.0 Classic is general room, 3.0 Elite is single private AC room).

care_supreme.note: No room rent restriction. The source does not state a co-pay, so 0 is assumed. Verify in your wording.
